commodity_bar_meaning.explanation: This chart illustrates the composition of agricultural exports by value across key commodity chapters.

country_donut_meaning.explanation: This chart visualizes the distribution of total export value across destination nations to assess geographic concentration risk.

country_donut_meaning.action: Initiate bilateral trade facilitation programs targeting emerging demand in China and India to reduce dependency on regional intermediaries.

market_share_table_meaning.explanation: This summary table outlines the proportional market share held by our top ten destination countries.

market_share_table_meaning.action: Establish direct trade corridors with non-ASEAN markets to bypass regional price-setting bottlenecks and enhance bargaining power.
